# Incident: Agent JP Mirror — `Generated by` Stamp Omitted and Placed Before Frontmatter

## Date

2026-05-27

## What happened

When creating `plugins/work-kit/agents/jp-mirror-translator.jp.md` (a JP mirror of an agent definition file), two mistakes were made:

1. The `<!-- Generated by work-kit/work-start v2.33.0 -->` provenance stamp was omitted entirely.
2. The JP mirror warning comment was placed **before** the YAML frontmatter instead of after it:

```md
<!-- This file is a Japanese mirror. ... -->  ← placed here (WRONG)
---
name: jp-mirror-translator
...
---
(content)
```

## Why it happened

- `mark-generated` was not invoked when creating the file by hand.
- The `insertion position rule` from mark-generated's SKILL.md was overlooked: "if the file has YAML frontmatter, insert immediately after the closing `---`."
- Without frontmatter, inserting at the top of the file is correct — but this agent file **has** frontmatter, so the top-of-file position was wrong.

## Fix applied

1. Invoked `/claude-kit:mark-generated --plugin work-kit --skill work-start --file jp-mirror-translator.jp.md` to get the correct comment block.
2. Moved the comment to immediately after the closing `---` of the frontmatter:

```md
---
name: jp-mirror-translator
...
---
<!-- Generated by work-kit/work-start v2.33.0 -->
<!-- This file is a Japanese mirror. ... -->
(content)
```

## Prevention

- Always invoke `mark-generated` when creating any generated file — do not write the stamp by hand.
- For files with YAML frontmatter, the comment goes **after** the closing `---`, not at the top of the file.
- A comment before `---` breaks GitHub Markdown rendering (the `---` is rendered as a horizontal rule instead of being parsed as frontmatter).
